title: Pharaoh Hatshepsut (Maatkare)
kingdom: New Kingdom of Egypt (The Imperial Age)
biography: One of Egypt's most successful female pharaohs who re-established vital trade networks, sponsored the famous expedition to the Land of Punt, and built the terraced mortuary temple at Deir el-Bahari.
internationalConnections: Dispatched five naval trade ships to Punt, returning with myrrh trees, frankincense, ivory, and gold.
